newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures dormant waiting for holiday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures dormant waiting for holiday.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures trading was dormant on Wednesday with traders expecting activity to be quiet over the next few days due to the Thanksgiving holiday in the United States later this week.

"It's just reflecting a sideways activity in the (United) States. We also have Thanksgiving holiday in the States, so I don't expect much activity," said Graham Smith, a trader at Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd.
Smith said although settlement prices were higher this did not mean much as there was no trade.
Unwinding of bull spreads and profit taking of the December/March spread pressed wheat futures in Chicago to a mostly lower close on Tuesday.
